names.description: The One whose mercy encompasses all of creation, providing for both believers and non-believers in this world.
names.benefit: Reciting this name brings compassion and mercy into your life and softens the heart.

names.description: He who acts with extreme kindness
names.benefit: Brings divine mercy and forgiveness. Relieves grief and anxiety when recited regularly.

names.description: The Sovereign Lord, Master of all dominion who has total control over all creation.
names.benefit: Grants respect and dignity. Protects from oppression when recited with conviction.

names.description: The One who is pure, perfect, and free from any defect or imperfection.
names.benefit: Purifies the heart from negative traits and brings spiritual cleanliness.

names.description: The One who is free from all defects and the giver of peace and safety.
names.benefit: Brings peace of mind, safety from harm, and protection from calamities.

names.description: The One who grants security and removes fear from the hearts of believers.
names.benefit: Strengthens faith and removes fear. Grants security and protection from danger.

names.description: The One who witnesses all things, protects and guards His creation with perfect care.
names.benefit: Provides protection and guardianship. Safeguards from evil and harmful situations.

names.description: The All-Powerful, the One who cannot be overcome, the Strong and Victorious.
names.benefit: Grants strength, honor, and victory over difficulties. Removes humiliation and weakness.

names.description: The One who compels His creation according to His will and mends what is broken.
names.benefit: Heals broken hearts, mends difficult situations, and grants courage in adversity.

names.description: The One who is supremely great, who has the right to be proud, possessing all glory.
names.benefit: Removes arrogance from the heart and helps one recognize true greatness.

names.description: The One who brings everything into existence from non-existence according to His perfect design.
names.benefit: Increases creativity and helps manifest ideas into reality through divine inspiration.

names.description: The One who creates perfectly, without any precedent or model, in flawless harmony.
names.benefit: Helps in creating new beginnings and brings order to chaotic situations.

names.description: The One who shapes and forms all creation in perfect proportion and beautiful form.
names.benefit: Brings beauty to life and helps in developing good character and appearance.

names.description: The One who forgives again and again, covering and pardoning all sins repeatedly.
names.benefit: Grants forgiveness of sins and helps overcome guilt. Opens doors of repentance.

names.description: The One who dominates and has ultimate power over all creation with absolute authority.
names.benefit: Overcomes enemies and obstacles. Grants victory over the ego and worldly temptations.

names.description: The One who continuously gives gifts and grants bounties without expecting anything in return.
names.benefit: Brings abundance, unexpected blessings, and opens doors of provision and opportunity.

names.description: The One who provides all sustenance and nourishment, both physical and spiritual, to all creation.
names.benefit: Increases provision and sustenance. Removes poverty and brings financial stability.

names.description: The One who opens all doors, reveals solutions, and judges between truth and falsehood.
names.benefit: Opens closed doors of opportunity, reveals solutions, and brings breakthrough in difficulties.

names.description: The One whose knowledge encompasses everything, past, present, and future, seen and unseen.
names.benefit: Increases knowledge and understanding. Helps in learning and gaining wisdom.

names.description: The One who withholds and constricts provision or souls according to His divine wisdom.
names.benefit: Helps control desires and brings discipline. Protects from overspending and excess.

names.description: The One who expands provisions, hearts, and souls with generosity and abundance.
names.benefit: Expands provision and opportunities. Brings relief from constraints and restrictions.

names.description: The One who lowers the status of the arrogant and proud according to His justice.
names.benefit: Removes pride and arrogance. Brings humility and awareness of one's true nature.

names.description: The One who raises and elevates the status of the humble and righteous.
names.benefit: Elevates status and brings honor. Grants recognition and success in endeavors.

names.description: The One who gives strength, power, and honor to whomever He wills.
names.benefit: Brings honor, respect, and dignity. Strengthens position and grants influence.

names.description: The One who humiliates and disgraces the arrogant according to divine justice.
names.benefit: Protects from humiliation by enemies and removes false pride from the heart.

names.description: The One who hears all sounds, voices, and secrets, nothing escapes His hearing.
names.benefit: Ensures prayers are heard and answered. Brings awareness that Allah listens to all.

names.description: The One who sees all that is visible and invisible, nothing is hidden from His sight.
names.benefit: Increases insight and perception. Opens spiritual vision and understanding.

names.description: The One who judges with perfect justice and whose judgment cannot be overturned.
names.benefit: Grants justice in disputes and helps make wise decisions with clarity.

names.description: The One who is absolutely fair and never does injustice to anyone.
names.benefit: Brings fairness and justice. Helps overcome oppression and establishes truth.

names.description: The One who is kind, gentle, and works in subtle ways beyond human comprehension.
names.benefit: Brings gentleness in affairs and reveals hidden solutions in difficult situations.

names.description: The One who is aware of all inner secrets and hidden realities.
names.benefit: Increases awareness and understanding of hidden matters and inner truths.

names.description: The One who is patient, does not rush to punish, and gives time for repentance.
names.benefit: Increases patience and tolerance. Brings calmness and forbearance in difficulties.

names.description: The One who is supremely great in power, status, and attributes beyond comprehension.
names.benefit: Brings awe and magnifies one's purpose. Grants perspective on life's challenges.

names.description: The One who forgives and covers sins completely, as if they never happened.
names.benefit: Grants complete forgiveness and helps overcome past mistakes with fresh starts.

names.description: The One who appreciates and rewards even the smallest good deeds abundantly.
names.benefit: Increases gratitude and brings multiplied rewards for good deeds and efforts.

names.description: The One who is exalted above all creation in status, power, and authority.
names.benefit: Elevates spiritual station and brings closeness to the divine presence.

names.description: The One who is greater than anything that can be imagined or conceived.
names.benefit: Makes worldly problems seem smaller and grants perspective on true greatness.

names.description: The One who preserves and protects all creation and never forgets anything.
names.benefit: Provides protection and preservation. Safeguards from harm and loss.

names.description: The One who provides all necessary nourishment and sustains all creation perfectly.
names.benefit: Ensures sustenance reaches you and provides what is needed at the right time.

names.description: The One who takes perfect account of all deeds and is sufficient for all needs.
names.benefit: Brings sufficiency in all matters. Allah alone is enough for those who trust.

names.description: The One who is majestic in greatness, worthy of reverence and exaltation.
names.benefit: Brings majesty to character and grants respect in the eyes of others.

names.description: The One who is extremely generous, giving abundantly without being asked.
names.benefit: Brings generosity and abundance. Opens doors of unexpected provision and blessings.

names.description: The One who watches over all creation with perfect awareness and care.
names.benefit: Increases mindfulness and brings awareness that Allah watches over all actions.

names.description: The One who responds to prayers and supplications of those who call upon Him.
names.benefit: Ensures prayers are answered. Brings hope that supplications will be fulfilled.

names.description: The One whose knowledge, mercy, and power encompass all things without limit.
names.benefit: Expands capacity and removes limitations. Brings vast opportunities and possibilities.

names.description: The One who is perfectly wise in all actions, decisions, and decrees.
names.benefit: Grants wisdom in decisions and helps understand divine wisdom in all situations.

names.description: The One who loves His righteous servants and is beloved by them.
names.benefit: Brings love into life and creates bonds of affection between people.

names.description: The One who is most glorious, honorable, and praised in all His attributes.
names.benefit: Brings glory and honor to one's endeavors and grants noble character.

names.description: The One who raises the dead and brings life after death on the Day of Resurrection.
names.benefit: Revives hope and brings new life to dead matters and stagnant situations.

names.description: The One who witnesses all things, nothing is hidden from His awareness.
names.benefit: Brings consciousness that Allah witnesses all actions, inspiring righteousness.

names.description: The One who is the ultimate truth and whose existence is the only absolute reality.
names.benefit: Reveals truth and helps distinguish between truth and falsehood clearly.

names.description: The One who is the best disposer of affairs and worthy of complete trust.
names.benefit: Brings trust and reliance on Allah. Removes worry about outcomes and affairs.

names.description: The One who possesses ultimate strength and power without any weakness.
names.benefit: Grants strength in weakness and provides power to overcome all obstacles.

names.description: The One whose strength is firm, unshakeable, and does not diminish or fail.
names.benefit: Brings firmness and stability in faith and steadfastness in difficulties.

names.description: The One who is the guardian, supporter, and protector of the believers.
names.benefit: Provides protection, friendship, and support from the divine guardian.

names.description: The One who is worthy of all praise and thanks in all circumstances.
names.benefit: Increases gratitude and brings blessings through praising Allah in all situations.

names.description: The One who has counted and recorded all things in perfect detail.
names.benefit: Brings awareness that all deeds are recorded, inspiring accountability.

names.description: The One who originates creation from nothing and begins all things.
names.benefit: Helps in starting new projects and brings success in new beginnings.

names.description: The One who restores creation and brings back life after death.
names.benefit: Restores what was lost and brings back good that has passed away.

names.description: The One who gives life to the dead and brings into existence all living things.
names.benefit: Revives dead hearts and brings life to lifeless situations and relationships.

names.description: The One who causes death and brings the soul's journey in this world to an end.
names.benefit: Reminds of mortality and helps prioritize what truly matters in life.

names.description: The One who is eternally alive and never dies, the source of all life.
names.benefit: Brings vitality and life force. Revives spirit and energizes the soul.

names.description: The One who sustains all existence and is completely self-sufficient, needing nothing.
names.benefit: Brings independence and self-sufficiency. Removes neediness and dependency.

names.description: The One who finds whatever He wills and lacks nothing, completely self-sufficient.
names.benefit: Helps find what is sought and reveals hidden treasures and opportunities.

names.description: The One who is most noble, glorious, and magnificent in all attributes.
names.benefit: Brings nobility to character and grants dignity in all circumstances.

names.description: The One who is unique, alone in His divinity without partner or equal.
names.benefit: Unifies the heart and removes confusion, bringing clarity and focus.

names.description: The One who is eternally needed by all, while needing none, absolutely self-sufficient.
names.benefit: Fulfills all needs and brings satisfaction. Allah is sufficient for all.

names.description: The One who has perfect power and ability to do anything He wills.
names.benefit: Grants capability and ability to achieve what seems impossible.

names.description: The One who has complete power and creates all power, determining all measures.
names.benefit: Brings complete power over difficulties and grants mastery over situations.

names.description: The One who brings forward and advances whom He wills in rank and status.
names.benefit: Expedites matters and brings advancement in position and spiritual rank.

names.description: The One who delays and holds back according to His wisdom and perfect timing.
names.benefit: Brings patience and understanding of divine timing in delayed matters.

names.description: The One who is first, having no beginning, existing before all creation.
names.benefit: Connects to the eternal and brings perspective beyond temporal concerns.

names.description: The One who is last, having no end, remaining after all creation has perished.
names.benefit: Prepares for the hereafter and brings focus on eternal matters.

names.description: The One who is evident and manifest through His signs in creation.
names.benefit: Reveals truth and makes hidden matters apparent and clear.

names.description: The One who is hidden, whose essence cannot be known except through His attributes.
names.benefit: Reveals hidden knowledge and unveils mysteries of the unseen.

names.description: The One who is the supreme governor, managing all affairs of creation.
names.benefit: Brings good governance in affairs and management of responsibilities.

names.description: The One who is supremely exalted above any imperfection or limitation.
names.benefit: Elevates status and raises spiritual rank beyond worldly concerns.

names.description: The One who is the ultimate source of goodness, kindness, and righteousness.
names.benefit: Brings goodness and righteousness. Inspires charitable deeds and kind actions.

names.description: The One who constantly accepts repentance and turns hearts back to Him.
names.benefit: Opens doors of repentance and helps turn away from sins repeatedly.

names.description: The One who justly punishes wrongdoers and takes retribution for injustice.
names.benefit: Protects from oppressors and brings justice against those who wrong others.

names.description: The One who pardons and erases sins completely, leaving no trace or consequence.
names.benefit: Completely erases past mistakes and removes consequences of wrongdoing.

names.description: The One who is exceedingly compassionate and gentle with His creation.
names.benefit: Brings gentleness and compassion. Softens difficult circumstances with kindness.

names.description: The One who owns and controls all sovereignty, giving dominion to whom He wills.
names.benefit: Grants authority and leadership. Brings success in positions of responsibility.

names.description: The One who possesses majesty and bounty, deserving of veneration and generosity.
names.benefit: Brings honor and glory. Grants nobility of character and generous spirit.

names.description: The One who is perfectly just and fair, establishing justice with equity.
names.benefit: Establishes justice and fairness. Brings balance and equity in all matters.

names.description: The One who gathers and assembles all creation on the Day of Judgment.
names.benefit: Unites scattered affairs and brings people together in harmony and purpose.

names.description: The One who is completely independent, needing nothing from creation.
names.benefit: Brings contentment and freedom from need. Grants self-sufficiency and independence.

names.description: The One who enriches and makes others free from want and need.
names.benefit: Brings wealth and enrichment. Removes poverty and grants abundance.

names.description: The One who prevents and withholds according to His wisdom and protection.
names.benefit: Protects from harm by preventing evil and dangerous situations.

names.description: The One who can cause difficulty or harm according to His perfect wisdom.
names.benefit: Understanding that trials come with wisdom helps accept and grow from difficulties.

names.description: The One who benefits and grants profit and advantage to His creation.
names.benefit: Brings benefit and advantage. Makes actions and efforts fruitful and productive.

names.description: The One who is the light that illuminates all creation and guides to truth.
names.benefit: Illuminates the path and brings clarity. Removes darkness from heart and life.

names.description: The One who guides to the right path and enlightens hearts with truth.
names.benefit: Provides guidance and shows the right path in times of confusion.

names.description: The One who creates in unprecedented ways, beyond any example or comparison.
names.benefit: Inspires unique creativity and helps create something new and unprecedented.

names.description: The One who remains forever, eternal and everlasting without end.
names.benefit: Connects to the eternal and helps prioritize what lasts beyond this world.

names.description: The One who remains after all creation perishes and inherits everything.
names.benefit: Reminds that all returns to Allah, bringing detachment from worldly possessions.

names.meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
names.description: The One who is righteous and guides to righteousness with perfect wisdom.
names.benefit: Guides to right decisions and brings wisdom in choosing the correct path.

names.description: The One who is patient, does not rush to punishment, and gives time for change.
names.benefit: Grants patience and perseverance. Helps endure trials with steadfastness.

names.description: The One who responds to all prayers and supplications of those who call.
names.benefit: Ensures all sincere prayers are heard and answered at the perfect time.
